WITH exam_by_sex AS (
  SELECT 
    p.SEX,
    COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID) as patient_count
  FROM Examination e
  JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID
  GROUP BY p.SEX
),
totals AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(patient_count) as total_patients,
    AVG(patient_count) as avg_count_per_sex
  FROM exam_by_sex
),
with_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    e.SEX,
    e.patient_count,
    e.patient_count * 1.0 / t.total_patients as share,
    t.avg_count_per_sex,
    e.patient_count - t.avg_count_per_sex as excess
  FROM exam_by_sex e
  CROSS JOIN totals t
),
above_avg AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM with_shares
  WHERE patient_count > avg_count_per_sex
)
SELECT 
  SUM(patient_count) as total_count,
  AVG(share) as avg_share,
  AVG(excess) as avg_excess
FROM above_avg;

assumptions.assumption: COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID) counts each patient once per sex group, regardless of multiple examination records per patient. This aligns with 'distinct examined patients' given the foreign key relationship.
Share is calculated as each sex's patient count divided by total patient count across all sexes.
Per-sex average equals total count ÷ number of distinct sex groups (treating NULL and blank as separate groups per request).
